basic_info.description: Unrivaled beachfront sanctuary! Two distinct and architecturally significant structures connected by a suspended bridge of glass make this home truly one of a kind. 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath private compound built on 3 street-to-street lots. With unparalleled ocean views, it is the perfect home for entertaining, family time, or relaxing at the beach. The main house built by Ernest Born is a superb example of Mid Century architecture completed in 1950. The Aidlin-Darling designed 3 story steel clad pavilion has walls of glass that open to a park like backyard the size of a city park with mature Cypress and Pine Trees. Admired by architects and historians, the house has been published in periodicals and books including Dwell, the New York Times and SF Curbed.
